raw_response.rationale: The full text (10 pages) conducts an institutional-regulatory review of Chile's Rural Sanitation Services Law No. 20.998 and environmental discharge regulations alongside a descriptive national baseline diagnosis compiled from internal SSSR records and the June 2024 Official SSSR Cadaster (2,441 recognized Rural Sanitation Services, 316 localities / 326 systems). All empirical tables (Tables 3-6) and figures (Figures 1-7) report strictly descriptive counts, percentages, and cross-tabulations across macro-zones, settlement density types, management models, and size segments without any regression models, hypothesis tests, standard errors, confidence intervals, or p-values. Therefore, flagging quantitative synthesis eligibility is overstated.
